title: Much Ado About Something
location: The House Up on the Hill, 26 Seir Hill Rd., Norwalk, CT
description: Join us for a beautiful night of cocktails, delicious bites, dancing, and live and silent auctions in support of Shakespeare on the Sound. Love to party? Join the gala committee and help shape the evening.

title: Opening Night Pre-show Reception
description: Kick off the 30th summer season with a pre-show reception before Much Ado About Nothing. Light bites, beer, wine, and soda included.

title: Directors' Discuss Much Ado
description: An in-depth conversation with Executive Director Aaron Simms and director David Frederick Mold about putting together this summer's MainStage production of Much Ado About Nothing.

title: SOS Book Club
description: Join Director of Education Stephanie Eiss and educator John Love for a guided discussion about the play. Rain date: Thursday, June 25.

title: Alumni Night Reception
description: Raise a glass to 30 years! Anyone who has worked with SOS as a volunteer, board member, cast, crew, or longtime supporter is invited. Light bites, beer, wine, and soda included.

title: Pay-What-You-Will Shakespeare
description: Two special evenings where admission is pay-what-you-will. Suggested donation: $25 adults, $5 children 12 and under.

title: Apprentice Company Matinee
description: An afternoon performance by our Apprentice Company. Walk-up admission only at the park box office.
